slides.title: Ex-US contractor pleads guilty in Ethiopia classified-info case
What he admitted
slides.body: Conspiring to pass classified US defense information to Ethiopian officials, 2021 to 2023.

slides.title: What happens next
slides.body: Sentencing is set for Apr 14, 2027. The plea deal recommends 120 to 262 months.

slides.title: Ethiopia's response
slides.body: None reported in the source. Single source, not independently verified.

slides.title: Open, lawful proceedings.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
